achievements.name: Course Clear
achievements.detail: Reach a goal pole and finish any course in Super Mario 3D World.

achievements.name: Cat Mario
achievements.detail: Touch a Super Bell and wear the cat suit while you clear a course.

achievements.name: Green Star
achievements.detail: Pick up a Green Star hidden somewhere in a course.

achievements.name: Golden Flag
achievements.detail: Touch the very top of a goal pole so that course's flag turns gold.

achievements.name: Course Stamp
achievements.detail: Find the stamp set in a course and add it to your stamp collection.

achievements.name: Sprixie Rescue
achievements.detail: Clear a castle or airship course and free the Sprixie Princess held there.

achievements.name: Captain Toad
achievements.detail: Lead Captain Toad to the Green Star in one of his puzzle courses.

achievements.name: Meowser
achievements.detail: Defeat Meowser and clear the final course of the main 3D World story.

achievements.name: Cat Shine
achievements.detail: Collect a Cat Shine while exploring Lake Lapcat in Bowser's Fury.

achievements.name: Giga Cat Mario
achievements.detail: Strike a Giga Bell on Lake Lapcat and fight as giant Giga Cat Mario.

achievements.name: Fury Bowser
achievements.detail: Gather Cat Shines and defeat Fury Bowser so the storm leaves Lake Lapcat.

achievements.name: Champion's Road
achievements.detail: Clear Champion's Road after that final course opens.
